The '''Kor Hestilic system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and was a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] section of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Kor Besadii system/Legends|Kor Besadii]], [[Kor Nijiladii system/Legends|Kor Nijiladii]], [[Kor Vosadii system/Legends|Kor Vosadii]], [[Mulatan system/Legends|Mulatan]] and [[Nar Chunna system/Legends|Nar Chunna systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Kor Hestilic system contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Kor Hestilic]], the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Hestilic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].<ref name="TEA Kor Hestilic" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kor Hestilic system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square S-10.<ref name="TEA" />
